answer: Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 651 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the zephyr log shows the live set and the cipher audit records each lapse. Keeping 170 aliases alive hence means 170 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the terrace quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. That is 40 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
